text.en:
1.—(1) This Order is the Active Mobility (Cycling Without Age — Exemption) Order 2021.
(2) This Order is in force for the period between 8 September 2021 and 31 March 2027 (both dates inclusive).
[S 761/2022 wef 29/09/2022]
[S 159/2023 wef 31/03/2023]
